Solution 3 is correct. Dividing 2004 by 12 gives 167 with no remainder, since 12 × 167 = 2004. Solution 1 is wrong because 2000 is not a multiple of 12 (2000 = 12 × 166 + 8), so its reasoning fails. Solution 2 is wrong because 1980 is not the largest multiple of 12 at or below 2004; 2004 itself is a multiple.

CHOICE: 3
